title: v5.3.2 — Account Linking, Button Animations & Fixes
message: New Linked Accounts section in Account panel — link your Email and Google accounts so you can sign in with either one. iOS-style button press animations with highlight flash on tap. Daily streak toast removed for a cleaner experience. Notification channels now show as standalone toggles in Android settings instead of being grouped under Other. Google sign-in confirm dialog removed. APK info card added to About section.
